d1_to_d2.format: UTF-8 CSV; one analyte determination per row
d1_to_d2.schema_map: Optional JSON object mapping canonical fields to source CSV column names
rules: Preserve source qualifiers and detection limits; do not impute censored values.
Populate species_or_oxide only when the reported quantity is explicitly a compound or species.
Provide WGS84 coordinates or leave canonical coordinates empty and retain source CRS evidence.
Do not delete duplicates before D2 QC.
Do not render null normalized values as zero.
Use a distinct symbol for censored observations.
Keep missing-coordinate records in a table/QC view and never place them at (0, 0).
Show candidate anomaly and operational confidence disclaimers.

d2_to_e1.machine_result: One JSON object on stdout mapping output roles to paths
d2_to_e1.determinism: Same input bytes, schema map and parameters must produce byte-identical outputs

prohibited_interpretations: Candidate anomaly proves mineralization or an ore deposit.
Operational confidence is a statistical probability or measurement accuracy.
